Additionally, Luria discusses investor concerns surrounding AI regulation, safety, and increasingly powerful models. Another focus is valuation and why many technology companies may appear attractive despite ongoing uncertainty. The interview also highlights the potential for AI-driven productivity gains across a wide range of industries and business functions. Looking ahead, Luria expects investors to continue monitoring AI adoption, semiconductor demand, cloud infrastructure growth, technology valuations, and emerging AI applications. Throughout the discussion, Luria shares perspectives on artificial intelligence, semiconductors, cloud computing, enterprise technology, innovation, market strategy, AI infrastructure, technology investing, productivity, and digital transformation. items.title: EMQQ Global on emerging markets and the AI opportunity
items.summary: Kevin Carter, Founder and Chief Investment Officer of EMQQ Global and the INQQ Fund joined Steve Darling from Proactive about the impact of artificial intelligence on emerging markets, the dominance of the AI “Mag Three” and investment opportunities across the emerging market internet sector. Carter highlighted Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), Samsung and SK Hynix as the leading beneficiaries of AI infrastructure spending, describing the semiconductor companies as the “picks and shovels” leaders of the AI buildout. He noted that these three companies have accounted for approximately 90% of emerging market index returns this year, highlighting their profitability amid continued investment in AI infrastructure. Carter also discussed the competition between the United States and China across five key layers of artificial intelligence: power, semiconductors, data centres, large language models and applications. He highlighted China's electricity capacity, the adoption of Chinese open AI models and their cost advantages. Turning to investment opportunities, Carter discussed the attractive valuations of emerging market internet companies, highlighting Tencent and MercadoLibre as businesses well positioned to deploy AI through their established digital platforms and extensive customer data. He also highlighted India's long-term digital growth opportunity, driven by smartphone adoption, increasing internet access and strong earnings growth. Muse users can now connect to Gopuff and let their agent shop more than 5,000 products, from fresh groceries to household essentials, without ever leaving the chat. Muse finds what they need at the nearest Gopuff, builds an order and checks out once approved. Orders are fulfilled by Gopuff and delivered in as fast as 15 minutes.

items.title: Altimetrik Achieves the AWS Agentic AI Specialization
items.summary: DETROIT, November 24, 2026--Altimetrik, an AI engineering company, has achieved the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Agentic AI Specialization in Agentic AI Consulting Services, a category within the AWS AI Competency. This specialization recognizes Altimetrik as an AWS Partner that enables customers to deploy smart, self-operating AI systems that can think, plan, and work independently to execute complex business processes.
